title.zh: v1.16.10 同源曲风对比：把关系图谱变成可操作课件
title.en: v1.16.10 Same-origin comparison: the relation graph becomes a usable lesson

highlights.zh: 对比视图新增「同源对比」行：针对当前曲风列出其源自/衍生/相关的曲风，点击即可加入对比，直接 A/B 比较律动源流
highlights.en: The compare view gained a 'same origin' row: for the current genre it lists what it derives from, what it led to and what it is related to — click to add any of them to the comparison and A/B the lineage

highlights.zh: 关系图谱此前只作为装饰性的谱系图存在，现在被解析成结构化的三组同源关系（去重、过滤未知 id 与自环），并新增 9 例完整性测试
highlights.en: The relation graph used to be decorative; it is now resolved into three structured groups (deduped, with unknown ids and self-loops filtered) with 9 integrity tests

highlights.zh: 如实说明：159 条代表性曲目外链需要真实内容创作，未凭空生成；本轮交付的是把现有关系数据变成教学功能
highlights.en: Stated honestly: the 159 representative-track links need real content authoring and were not invented; this release turns the existing relation data into a teaching feature instead
